messages:
eva: @mike_legal heads up — Acme wants to add a subsidiary as a signing entity and they require an AML / sanctions clause in the MSA. They also want the order form e-signed with two signers (legal + finance). Any hard blockers on our side?

mike_legal: quick take: we can accept an addendum but need counterparty legal entity name + tax id. AML language should be scoped to transaction screening only; avoid open-ended warranties.

sara_procurement: finance needs the PO before we release seats. can we attach `PO: #` to the order form and route to their AP inbox? also need billing contact.

josh_eng: technical note: Dedicated POC requires a signed DPA before we share infra details. is the DPA update needed for the subsidiary as well?

mike_legal: @josh_eng yes, DPA must list all entities that will process data. i'll draft an addendum that enumerates the subsidiary and references the SOW/order form.

anna_cust_success: customer prefers DocuSign but mentioned they might require HSM audit trail later. do we support HSM-backed signatures for order forms?

liam_security: we support KMS/HSM-backed signing on Dedicated/Private plans. hosted customers get audit logs + SOC2. FIPS/HSM attestation is an enterprise add-on. which path is Acme taking?

eva: they're planning Dedicated POC in us-west. execs want the order form signed today to kick off procurement. can we do interim DocuSign and swap to HSM later?

mike_legal: interim DocuSign is acceptable if addendum permits amending signature method. i'll add: "Signature method: parties agree DocuSign acceptable until replaced by HSM-backed workflow upon mutual written agreement."

sara_procurement: finance wants Net30 on the order form. customer asked for Net45. any compromise?

eva: suggest Net30 + 5% early payment credit if they can do Net15. open to negotiation.

josh_eng: blocker: we can't provision POC infra or share endpoints until DPA is signed. legal can we expedite?

mike_legal: i'll prioritize drafting the addendum + DPA amendment today. need full legal entity text and tax id from Acme to populate docs.

anna_cust_success: asking Acme now, will report back in this thread.

eva: checklist: 1) acme entity + tax id (anna) 2) draft addendum + DPA amend (mike) 3) e-sign route decision: DocuSign interim or HSM (liam + anna) 4) PO + billing contact (sara) 5) confirm net terms (finance)

esign-bot: created envelope 0a1b2c for `orderform-acme` (DocuSign) — awaiting signatures.

anna_cust_success: Acme confirmed entity: "Acme Industrial Holdings, Inc." EIN 12-3456789. billing contact accounts-payable@acme.example.com

mike_legal: got it. i'll push a PR with addendum + DPA amendment in ~2 hours. tagging @sara_procurement for PO attachment language.

sara_procurement: include this snippet on the order form: `Billing contact: accounts-payable@acme.example.com / PO required / Net30 unless otherwise agreed`. :thumbsup:

eva: holding kickoff until signed order form + DPA, but ok to run technical preflight once addendum in review. thanks all. :wave:
